protocol.acceptance: Highest full-day-model calibration quantile from the recorded grid preserving each original ML-detected event on validation E1-E7, plus hybrid FP reduction and preserved hybrid event coverage. Sample recall and delay trade-offs are disclosed. Initial .999 candidate rejected after losing ML event coverage. No final-test tuning.
